title: engine narrator
description: GET /v1/engine/narrator/status (P1, N2; ENG-413 WP5): enabled false with why when the engine serves no narrator (no QWEN38_NARRATOR_MODEL, or no extension builds one over its slot); else the narrator's own status (engine-ext-v1 3.0 narrator.status): its settings, its slot, the line limits and the thought summaries' settings
